title: ToT Storefront .tot/config.json
description: The store's identity, its file layout, and its declared platform facts (displayName, siteType, compliance, capabilities, features, embeds). These facts apply identically in `tot dev`, hosted preview, and the live site. Every key here is one the platform reads. A key it does not read renders nothing, so your editor flags it here, and `tot validate` reports it as a warning naming the key you most likely meant; going live then waits for the store owner to approve it. Do NOT fabricate compliance facts.

$schema.description: Editor hint pointing at this schema. Ignored by the platform.

tenant.description: The store's registered id — its domain, e.g. "acme-vapor.example". Must equal `scope`.

scope.description: The store's data scope. Must equal `tenant` (the registered id).

mappings.description: Where each part of this repo lands in the storefront. `workspace` is the path in this repo; `repo` is the storefront target under tenants/<tenant>/.

workspace.description: Path in this repo, e.g. "content/" or "theme.json".

repo.description: Storefront target, e.g. "tenants/acme-vapor.example/content/". Use the registered id as the tenant segment.

kind.description: "file" for a single file, "tree" for a directory.

hostPlatform.description: Declares that this checkout is served by the ToT storefront, so `tot validate` treats the platform's commerce routes (/collections, /products, /cart, ...) as existing.

sample.description: Set by `tot dev --sample` on a scaffolded sample checkout. Do not set by hand.

seed.description: Provenance written by the platform when it seeds a new store repo. Do not edit.

displayName.description: The store's name as visitors read it, e.g. "Prime Vapor Club": the page-title suffix ("About — Prime Vapor Club"), og:site_name, the Organization structured-data name, the breadcrumb root, the default blog heading and the default copyright line. Unset = the name the store was provisioned with, often its bare domain.

siteType.description: commerce = a store with catalog + managed checkout (the default); marketing = a content/landing site with no cart.

capabilities.description: Build-time capability defaults; a committed capabilities.json overrides them per environment. Cannot weaken the compliance floor.

embeds.description: Reviewed third-party embed providers this store uses, by slug (e.g. "youtube", "vimeo"). The platform owns each provider's exact origins.

features.description: Per-flag overrides of the siteType defaults. List only the flags you want to flip.

commerceSitemap.description: Product/collection URLs in the XML sitemap.
